content: {"summary":"On 22 Nov 2025 orders-db-01.prod.internal returned SQLSTATE 53300, refusing new connections and causing ORD‑5003 errors in orders‑api. The database has 300 max connections (3 reserved), leaving 297 usable slots. orders‑api pods can use at most 75 slots, so the remaining ~222 slots were held by an idle batch Job in the commerce namespace, exhausting the pool and triggering the error.","likely_cause":"Idle connections leaked by a batch Job in the commerce namespace exhausted the usable connection slots on orders‑db‑01.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"The server logged a 53300 error on orders-db-01 at 22:16 UTC","evidence_ids":["log:4526"],"quote":"ERROR orders-db-01.prod.internal FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for roles with the SUPERUSER attribute"},{"text":"orders-db allows 300 max connections, 3 reserved, so 297 usable slots","evidence_ids":["RB-012#3"],"quote":"orders-db | orders-api, `pg` Pool `max` 25, 3 pods | 3 × 25 = 75 | 300 − 3 = 297"},{"text":"orders‑api pods can open at most 75 client slots","evidence_ids":["RB-012#3"],"quote":"orders-db | orders-api, `pg` Pool `max` 25, 3 pods | 3 × 25 = 75"},{"text":"A batch Job in the commerce namespace held about 222 idle sessions","evidence_ids":["INC-0103#0"],"quote":"A batch Job ... had been holding open about 222 sessions that did nothing"},{"text":"Those 222 idle sessions plus the 75 from orders‑api exactly filled the 297 usable slots, causing new connections to be refused","evidence_ids":["INC-0103#1"],"quote":"222 idle sessions plus those 75 come to 297, exactly the usable total"}],"next_checks":["Confirm the batch Job has been stopped and its idle connections terminated","Run the RB-012 query to verify current slot usage on orders-db-01","Monitor orders-db connection usage for recurrence","Review other services for similar connection‑leak patterns"]}
